destination.title: Inflation, supersymmetry and cosmological consistency
destination.question: Which gravitational and supersymmetric constructions support controlled inflation and acceptable subsequent evolution, and how do stabilization, field content, supersymmetry breaking and gravitino dynamics constrain them?
destination.summary: A proposed umbrella for related model-building and consistency questions. Different mechanisms, dimensions, vacuum histories and particle-production channels remain distinct below the overview level.

systems: Supergravity inflation and coupled moduli or partner fields
Gauge-field inflation and extended acceleration models as comparisons
targets: Potential flatness, inflationary predictions and exits
Reheating, relic abundance and fermionic consistency
regimes: Inflation, its termination, postinflationary evolution and specified late-time vacua
assumptions: Membership does not establish a shared stabilization mechanism, field content or ultraviolet completion
conventions: Observational statements retain their source dates
Proposed compatibility mechanisms and conjectural bounds remain questions under examination
includes: Useful boundary comparisons outside a narrower supergravity core
excludes: A universal relation between inflationary Hubble scale and vacuum gravitino mass
Automatic identification of sound-speed zeros with catastrophic physical production
Automatic string embedding of every supergravity model

sources.title: Volume modulus inflection point inflation and the gravitino mass problem

evidence.text: Can volume-modulus inflection-point inflation support a gravitino much lighter than the inflationary Hubble scale with simpler superpotentials, and what parameter and initial-condition tuning remains?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supergravity chaotic inflation with functional freedom in the inflaton potential accommodate low-scale supersymmetry breaking, visible matter and reheating while avoiding cosmological problems from light moduli and gravitinos?

sources.title: Large tensor spectrum of BICEP2 in the natural SUSY hybrid model

evidence.text: Can two-field natural SUSY hybrid inflation accommodate the historical targets r≈0.16 and nζ≈0.96, provide about 50 e-folds, and avoid Hubble-induced inflaton masses with a sub-Planckian decay constant?

sources.title: Three-form multiplet and Inflation

evidence.text: Can the stabilizer field and its inflaton coupling in supergravity inflation be interpreted through a three-form multiplet, explaining the shift symmetry and suggesting a microscopic string origin?

sources.title: Inflation, de Sitter Landscape and Super-Higgs effect

evidence.text: Can supergravity with one inflaton multiplet and one nilpotent multiplet describe inflation, a positive late-time vacuum energy and adjustable supersymmetry breaking, while avoiding additional Polonyi scalars and simplifying the fermionic super-Higgs sector?

sources.title: Natural Inflation from 5D SUGRA and Low Reheat Temperature

evidence.text: Can the gauge-inflaton branch of an earlier five-dimensional conformal-SUGRA construction reconcile natural-inflation observables and the required horizon-exit e-fold count with its microscopic decay and reheating history? The analysis emphasizes unsuppressed tensor amplitudes and potentially very low reheating temperatures.

sources.title: Planck, LHC, and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Can logarithmic-Kähler α-attractor supergravity models retain their successful inflationary predictions while also describing a tiny positive vacuum energy and supersymmetry breaking of adjustable strength, without introducing an additional Polonyi scalar?

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Low Energy Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can high-scale natural inflation coexist with low-scale or unbroken supersymmetry while addressing both effective trans-Planckian axion motion and stabilization of the saxionic partners in a string-inspired description?

sources.title: Starobinsky-like inflation and running vacuum in the context of Supergravity

evidence.text: Can dynamically broken SUGRA with a massive gravitino phase supply a microscopic realization of running vacuum, connecting Starobinsky-like inflation to radiation domination and an effective late-time dark-energy evolution?

sources.title: Cosmological $\alpha$-attractors and de Sitter landscape

evidence.text: Can supergravity α-attractors combine inflation, controllable vacuum energy and supersymmetry breaking while retaining their inflationary predictions under generic inflaton–uplifting couplings? A related question is whether curved Kähler geometry can support arbitrary inflaton potentials.

sources.title: Microscopic Origin of Volume Modulus Inflation

evidence.text: Can identifiable string corrections generate volume-modulus inflection-point inflation and a later large-volume minimum, allowing the gravitino mass to decrease after inflation? How do flux-superpotential tuning and multifield initial conditions constrain this mechanism?

sources.title: Cosmology with orthogonal nilpotent superfields

evidence.text: Can constrained multiplets embed full single-field inflationary dynamics in nonlinearly realized local supersymmetry while removing the sgoldstino, sinflaton, and inflatino? How do the constraints alter the scalar potential and simplify gravitino dynamics?

sources.title: Challenges for D-brane large-field inflation with stabilizer fields

evidence.text: Can D-brane-generated bilinear superpotentials realize large-field chaotic inflation with a stabilizer after heavy-modulus backreaction, while maintaining stability and separation from moduli and Kaluza–Klein scales?

sources.title: Gravitino Problem in Minimal Supergravity Inflation

evidence.text: Does the minimal inflationary supergravity EFT with orthogonal nilpotent superfields produce a cosmologically dangerous nonthermal gravitino abundance after inflation, and how does the answer depend on the gravitino mass function and EFT cutoff?

sources.title: Unified model of D-term inflation

evidence.text: Can D-term hybrid inflation be embedded in supergravity while explaining the FI scale, stabilizing charged scalars and the FI modulus, controlling the η problem, fitting the scalar tilt and avoiding dangerous waterfall cosmic strings?

sources.title: Constrained superfields from inflation to reheating

evidence.text: Can constrained-superfield supergravity retain only the inflaton and metric as independent bosons while preserving the fermions needed to describe inflation, preheating and reheating without misidentifying inflatino production as vacuum-gravitino production?

sources.title: Inflation from High-Scale Supersymmetry Breaking

evidence.text: Can dynamical supersymmetry breaking near the GUT scale also generate the inflationary energy scale, while supporting viable D-term hybrid inflation and a visible-sector B−L waterfall transition?

sources.title: Chromo-Natural inflation in Supergravity

evidence.text: Can chromo-natural inflation be embedded in supergravity with controlled partner fields and consistent truncations, and can its required large axion–gauge coupling arise from another stabilized scalar rather than a large input coefficient?

sources.title: Deriving the Inflaton in Compactified M-theory with a De Sitter Vacuum

evidence.text: Can flux-free compactified M-theory identify a modulus inflaton, admit de Sitter vacua and keep the remaining moduli stable during inflation at a Hubble scale much larger than the vacuum gravitino mass?

sources.title: Generalized dilaton-axion models of inflation, de Sitter vacua and spontaneous SUSY breaking in supergravity

evidence.text: Can one dilaton–axion chiral multiplet and one vector multiplet with an alternative FI term jointly realize viable inflation, a tunable de Sitter vacuum, and spontaneous supersymmetry breaking in N=1 supergravity?

sources.title: Minimal Starobinsky supergravity coupled to a dilaton-axion superfield

evidence.text: Can minimal Starobinsky supergravity retain viable inflation after coupling its massive vector multiplet to a no-scale dilaton-axion multiplet, while stabilizing both added scalars above the inflationary Hubble scale?

sources.title: Shifted $\mu$-hybrid inflation, gravitino dark matter, and observable gravity waves

evidence.text: Can shifted supersymmetric μ-hybrid inflation in SU(4)c×SU(2)L×SU(2)R remove primordial monopoles, generate the MSSM μ term, and accommodate reheating and gravitino dark matter constraints while producing potentially observable primordial tensors?

sources.title: A Solution to the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture versus Inflation Tension via Supergravity

evidence.text: How can one retain one inflaton while removing the stabilizer and imaginary-inflaton directions? The construction restricts two complex fields to S=0 and Im Φ=0, with Kähler-potential symmetries organizing the transverse terms.

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: How does removing the inflatino and imaginary scalar through orthogonal constraints change gravitino propagation relative to ordinary chiral-superfield models?

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Does relating the gravitino mass to supersymmetry breaking and scalar dynamics prevent the sound-speed zeros found for an independent Rarita–Schwinger spectator?

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Can gravitational production of a massive spin-3/2 field populate momenta up to an effective theory's cutoff after inflation, and which supergravity constructions prevent or retain this behavior?

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: When does gravitational production of massive spin-3/2 particles after inflation become UV dominated, and can supergravity prevent the associated vanishing helicity-1/2 sound speed?

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Does string theory impose an order-one lower bound on gravitino sound speed in addition to excluding exact zeros?

sources.title: Slow and Safe Gravitinos

evidence.text: When can the longitudinal gravitino's nominal sound speed vanish during post-inflationary oscillations, and does this imply catastrophic ultraviolet production once all dynamical fermions and superfield constraints are included?

sources.title: Minimal supergravity inflation without slow gravitino

evidence.text: Can supergravity inflation retain only the real inflaton, graviton and massive gravitino while avoiding catastrophic production caused by a vanishing longitudinal-gravitino propagation speed, and what conventional gravitino constraints remain?

sources.title: A minimal gauge inflation model

evidence.text: Retain the first Fourier harmonic for analytic slow-roll predictions of curvature perturbations, spectral index, tensor ratio and non-Gaussianity. Compare these estimates with numerical results in Table 1.

sources.title: Volume modulus inflection point inflation and the gravitino mass problem

evidence.text: Construct the supergravity F-term potential, impose W=0 and ∂T W=0 for supersymmetric Minkowski minima, and tune an additional minimum toward a flat inflection point. Inspect both inflaton and axion curvatures rather than only the t-direction potential.

sources.title: Chaotic inflation and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Reheating is studied through scalar decay vertices, chiral-fermion and gravitino couplings evaluated at the vacuum, and inflaton-dependent gauge kinetic functions. The late perturbative treatment requires a decay rate that remains nonzero as the oscillation amplitude vanishes.

sources.title: Large tensor spectrum of BICEP2 in the natural SUSY hybrid model

evidence.text: They apply imported two-field slow-roll expressions for scalar and tensor spectra, including dependence on the end-of-inflation hypersurface through R, ū, and v̄, and estimate durations using slow-roll field integrals.

sources.title: Three-form multiplet and Inflation

evidence.text: For practical on-shell calculations, import the prescription of treating S as an ordinary chiral multiplet and replacing W by W+if₀S, without explicit three-form boundary terms.

sources.title: Inflation, de Sitter Landscape and Super-Higgs effect

evidence.text: Identify the goldstino through gravitino–spinor mixing and impose a local supersymmetry unitary gauge at the vacuum. Construct uplifts by shifting f or g by a constant, or rescaling f; subtracting linear terms from arbitrary functions enforces f′(0)=g′(0)=0.

sources.title: How accidental was inflation?

evidence.text: How sensitively do supergravity inflation models depend on relative couplings, and can small departures from their Starobinsky or new-inflation limits improve CMB agreement while alleviating large-field initial-condition problems? The focus is potential-flatness tuning rather than the overall inflationary hierarchy.

sources.title: Hybrid inflation in high-scale supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can supergravity hybrid inflation remain viable with high-scale supersymmetry by cancelling or suppressing the gravitino-dependent inflaton tadpole, while also stabilizing the moduli?

sources.title: Anomaly-induced inflaton decay and gravitino-overproduction problem

evidence.text: Can quantum anomalies induce inflaton decay into gauge sectors without direct inflaton–gauge couplings, and does decay into a dynamical supersymmetry-breaking sector produce dangerous nonthermal gravitinos even at low reheating temperature?

sources.title: Aether SUSY breaking: can aether be alternative to F-term SUSY breaking?

evidence.text: Can scalar derivative backgrounds or vector condensation replace physical F- or D-term expectation values as sources of spontaneous SUSY breaking, while producing accelerated expansion and visible-sector mass splitting?

sources.title: Hybrid inflation from supergravity D terms

evidence.text: Can an anomalous supergravity D-term drive hybrid inflation with a sufficiently light inflaton, satisfy the historical density-perturbation normalization, and arise from ingredients available in string-derived supergravity?

sources.title: Inflaton decay through supergravity effects

evidence.text: Can supergravity induce inflaton decays without direct global-SUSY interactions, and do the resulting reheating floor and nonthermal gravitinos constrain high-scale inflation?

sources.title: Supergravity, M theory and cosmology

evidence.text: Can extended supergravity accommodate late-time de Sitter acceleration, and can D-brane constructions reproduce hybrid inflation, including its exit into a supersymmetric vacuum?

sources.title: Inflation near a metastable de Sitter vacuum from moduli stabilisation

evidence.text: Can the minimal ingredients producing a perturbatively stabilised metastable de Sitter vacuum also support realistic volume-modulus inflation? How stable is that vacuum, and what additional physics could end inflation?

sources.title: Shift symmetry and inflation in supergravity

evidence.text: Can mildly broken inflaton shift symmetry and modulus stabilization be combined in N=1 supergravity to obtain a sufficiently flat F-term inflationary potential, and how does the resulting two-field evolution differ from chaotic and hybrid inflation?

sources.title: NonAbelian discrete gauge symmetries and inflation

evidence.text: Can nonabelian discrete gauge symmetries protect a slow-roll inflaton potential against gravitational-strength corrections while also supplying special field values at which hybrid inflation ends?

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a cosmological EFT containing a massive gravitino remain consistent after quantization of its longitudinal mode? The examples concern broken local supersymmetry, FRW evolution, and the constant-mass Rarita–Schwinger limit of supergravity.

sources.title: The Gravitino-overproduction problem in inflationary universe

evidence.text: How severely does direct inflaton decay into gravitinos constrain supergravity inflation across gravitino masses from approximately 1 keV to 100 TeV, especially with nonminimal inflaton–SUSY-breaking Kähler couplings?

sources.title: Coupled fields in external background with application to nonthermal production of gravitinos

evidence.text: How can coupled bosonic and fermionic fields in time-dependent classical backgrounds be quantized with well-defined physical occupation numbers, and does preheating produce dangerous gravitinos when inflation and vacuum supersymmetry breaking occur in separate sectors?

sources.title: Supergravity based inflation models: a review

evidence.text: How can supergravity inflation evade Hubble-scale inflaton masses and the exponential obstruction to large fields? The review presents representative models and extends the discussion to nonminimal Higgs inflation.

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Does oscillatory pressure after inflation drive the longitudinal gravitino sound speed through zero? The example assumes a locally quadratic inflaton potential and constant gravitino mass.

sources.title: Higgs in nilpotent supergravity: Vacuum energy and Festina Lente

evidence.text: Can constrained-superfield supergravity accommodate supersymmetry breaking, electroweak breaking and inflation ending at zero vacuum energy, while satisfying the Festina Lente bound during inflation?

sources.title: Gravitino overproduction in inflaton decay

evidence.text: Can direct inflaton decay into gravitino pairs overproduce unstable gravitinos even when reheating satisfies the usual thermal-production bound, and how does this constrain new, hybrid, and symmetry-protected chaotic inflation?

sources.title: High-Scale SUSY from Sgoldstino Inflation

evidence.text: Can a single sgoldstino sector support a finely tuned positive vacuum energy, spontaneous F-term SUSY breaking and viable inflection-point inflation, while transmitting a high SUSY-breaking scale to the MSSM?

sources.title: Large Field Ranges from Aligned and Misaligned Winding

evidence.text: Can the large-field-range effective theory also support the inflationary mass scale while keeping the volume modulus stabilized? A further question is whether an uplift to a suitable positive potential preserves the delicate stabilization.

sources.title: Salvage of too slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Does a vanishing sound-speed parameter for the vacuum longitudinal gravitino imply catastrophic particle production once all coupled spin-1/2 degrees of freedom in linearly realised supergravity are retained?

sources.title: Inflationary models with a flat potential enforced by nonAbelian discrete gauge symmetries

evidence.text: Can explicit low-energy supergravity models use nonabelian discrete gauge symmetries to protect inflaton flatness, provide viable hybrid or mutated-hybrid exits, and permit unusually low inflationary energy scales?

sources.title: Combining High-scale Inflation with Low-energy SUSY

evidence.text: Can high-scale inflation coexist with low-energy supersymmetry when modulus stabilization would ordinarily relate the inflationary Hubble scale to today's gravitino mass? The proposed resolution separates stabilization during inflation from stabilization afterward.

sources.title: Observable r, gravitino dark matter, and non-thermal leptogenesis in no-scale supergravity

evidence.text: Can shifted hybrid inflation in no-scale supersymmetric SU(5) simultaneously dilute monopoles, support potentially observable primordial tensors, satisfy dimension-5 proton-decay constraints, and permit nonthermal leptogenesis with viable gravitino cosmology?

sources.title: Moduli Backreaction on Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Can KKLT volume stabilization coexist with cosmological α-attractor inflation without destructive backreaction, and what does their coupling imply for inflationary endpoints and the relation between H and the vacuum gravitino mass?

sources.title: SUGRA chaotic inflation and moduli stabilisation

evidence.text: When can shift-symmetric SUGRA chaotic inflation coexist with KKLT-like modulus stabilization once the modulus remains dynamical during inflation, and can the surviving model have observable departures from quadratic inflation?

sources.title: Volume Modulus Inflation and the Gravitino Mass Problem

evidence.text: Can high-scale inflation coexist with a present TeV-scale gravitino in large-volume compactifications, while avoiding destabilization and post-inflationary overshooting of the compactification minimum?

sources.title: Ultraviolet completion of Starobinsky inflation

evidence.text: Can higher-curvature deformations of Starobinsky inflation admit a no-scale N=1 supergravity construction and heterotic string embedding while addressing sgoldstino instability and initial conditions within the inflationary EFT?

sources.title: Hybrid inflation from supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can a neutral waterfall multiplet extend inflation by supersymmetry breaking so that inflation and observable-sector supersymmetry breaking have parametrically separate scales, while retaining hilltop predictions and a tunable near-Minkowski vacuum?

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Can inflation evolve independently of a constant gravitino mass when supersymmetry breaking is carried by a nilpotent sector with no moving scalar?

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Does a nilpotent-superfield construction avoid longitudinal sound-speed zeros? The example permits a heavy inflatino and reports orthogonal scalar motion and supersymmetry breaking with independently specified norm scales.

sources.title: Nonthermal production of gravitinos and inflatinos

evidence.text: Does efficient nonthermal fermion production after inflation produce dangerous late-time gravitinos, or predominantly inflatinos, when inflation and vacuum supersymmetry breaking belong to separate sectors?

sources.title: Helical Phase Inflation and Monodromy in Supergravity Theory

evidence.text: Can a complex-field phase drive supergravity inflation along a helical trajectory while other scalars remain stabilized? The paper examines the origin of superpotential monodromy, natural-inflation variants, no-scale realizations, the relation to shift-symmetric inflation, and claimed avoidance of UV sensitivity.

sources.title: D term inflation

evidence.text: Can D-term-dominated inflation avoid the generic supergravity inflaton mass of order H, and how does this change the inflationary curvature of moduli and other flat directions?

sources.title: Eluding the Gravitino Overproduction in Inflaton Decay

evidence.text: Can dynamical supersymmetry breaking suppress nonthermal gravitino production sufficiently to make inflation compatible with pure gravity mediation and heavy gravitinos, while including hidden-sector decays and coherent Polonyi oscillations?

sources.title: Inflation, moduli (de)stabilization and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can a superpotential that is relatively large during inflation but small in the final vacuum stabilize moduli while allowing Hinf much larger than the final gravitino mass? What happens to stabilization during the termination of hybrid inflation?

sources.title: Backreaction in Axion Monodromy, 4-forms and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the D7-position inflaton be made light independently of the saxions controlling its metric? The proposed superpotential separates its lifting coefficient mu from closed-sector stabilization data in W_0.

sources.title: Inflection-point sgoldstino inflation in no-scale supergravity

evidence.text: Can one sgoldstino sector realize observationally acceptable inflection-point inflation, stabilized supersymmetry breaking and a tunable positive vacuum energy, and what parameter tuning and superpartner scales follow?

sources.title: Single-Superfield Helical-Phase Inflation

evidence.text: Can helical-phase inflation in supergravity be realized with a single chiral superfield, using stabilization of its radial scalar instead of an additional stabilizer superfield, while obtaining positive quadratic, plateau or natural-inflation potentials?

sources.title: False vacuum inflation with Einstein gravity

evidence.text: Can two-field false-vacuum inflation in Einstein gravity produce viable perturbations and a successful end to inflation, and can its potential arise naturally in supersymmetry or string-derived supergravity? The paper emphasizes vacuum domination and second-order transitions, while also treating first-order bubble nucleation.

Can a neutral waterfall multiplet extend inflation by supersymmetry breaking so that inflation and observable-sector supersymmetry breaking have parametrically separate scales, while retaining hilltop predictions and a tunable near-Minkowski vacuum?

Can a single sgoldstino sector support a finely tuned positive vacuum energy, spontaneous F-term SUSY breaking and viable inflection-point inflation, while transmitting a high SUSY-breaking scale to the MSSM?
Can nonabelian discrete gauge symmetries protect a slow-roll inflaton potential against gravitational-strength corrections while also supplying special field values at which hybrid inflation ends?

Can explicit low-energy supergravity models use nonabelian discrete gauge symmetries to protect inflaton flatness, provide viable hybrid or mutated-hybrid exits, and permit unusually low inflationary energy scales?
Can D-term-dominated inflation avoid the generic supergravity inflaton mass of order H, and how does this change the inflationary curvature of moduli and other flat directions?
Can extended supergravity accommodate late-time de Sitter acceleration, and can D-brane constructions reproduce hybrid inflation, including its exit into a supersymmetric vacuum?

Can mildly broken inflaton shift symmetry and modulus stabilization be combined in N=1 supergravity to obtain a sufficiently flat F-term inflationary potential, and how does the resulting two-field evolution differ from chaotic and hybrid inflation?

destination.title: CMB inference, primordial physics and electromagnetic propagation
destination.question: What can CMB observations and their theoretical interpretation establish about primordial physics, cosmic propagation and cosmological dynamics, given foregrounds, instrumental errors and model limitations?
destination.summary: A broad navigation family connecting measurements, forecasts, statistical tests and theoretical viability questions. The supplied numerical membership needs explicit boundaries around questions lacking a demonstrated CMB connection.

systems: CMB temperature, polarization, lensing and blackbody radiation
CMB-producing cosmological models and CMB–galaxy correlations
targets: Cosmic polarization rotation and its identification
Primordial tensors, scalar spectra, statistical properties and defects
Survey capabilities and control of measurement errors
Validity of selected warped-throat and electromagnetic-propagation models
regimes: Primordial generation, subsequent photon propagation and late-time cosmological structure
assumptions: Model assumptions belong to their individual questions.
No shared Swampland premise or common new-physics mechanism is imposed.
conventions: Preserve source-specific data releases, confidence conventions and rotation signs.
includes: Different observables, systems and methods linked by a substantive CMB question
excludes: Automatic equivalence of questions sharing polarization or dark-sector terminology
GRB shock magnetogenesis as a CMB question
An inferred CMB prediction from the supplied finite-amplitude Weyl-selection description

sources.title: Planck 2013 results. XXV. Searches for cosmic strings and other topological defects

evidence.text: What constraints do Planck 2013 CMB power spectra and complementary non-Gaussian searches place on cosmic strings, semilocal strings and global textures?

sources.title: Planck 2015 results. XVI. Isotropy and statistics of the CMB

evidence.text: Do full-mission Planck temperature anisotropies, and the usable polarization measurements, satisfy primordial Gaussianity and statistical isotropy? Which previously reported anomalies persist under component separation, masking, simulation comparisons, and corrections for data-driven choices?

sources.title: CMB-S4 Science Book, First Edition

evidence.text: What ground-based CMB measurements and instrument capabilities would cross useful thresholds for testing inflation, measuring neutrino masses, discovering light relics, constraining dark matter and dark energy, and testing gravity?

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters

evidence.text: What cosmological parameters follow from final full-mission Planck temperature, polarization, and CMB-lensing measurements; how consistent are those measurements with base ΛCDM, selected extensions, and external cosmological probes?

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. IX. Constraints on primordial non-Gaussianity

evidence.text: What constraints do Planck full-mission temperature and E-mode bispectra and trispectra place on primordial non-Gaussianity and the early-Universe scenarios that generate it?

sources.title: CMB-S4 Science Case, Reference Design, and Project Plan

evidence.text: What can a greatly expanded ground-based CMB survey establish about primordial gravitational waves, light relics, neutrino mass, cosmic structure and the variable millimeter sky, and what instrument and analysis requirements follow?

sources.title: A numerical study of observational systematic errors in lensing analysis of CMB polarization

evidence.text: How do gain, polarization-angle, and pointing errors propagate through internal CMB lensing reconstruction into loss of large-scale B-mode delensing efficiency?

sources.title: The Origin of Parity Violation in Polarized Dust Emission and Implications for Cosmic Birefringence

evidence.text: Can projected misalignment between interstellar filaments and magnetic fields explain Galactic dust TB and EB, and how should intrinsic foreground EB affect inference of isotropic cosmic birefringence?

sources.title: CMB mode coupling with isotropic polarization rotation

evidence.text: Can parity-violating CMB mode coupling measure an isotropic polarization rotation angle, and provide a competitive cross-check of the conventional EB power-spectrum measurement?

sources.title: New physics from the polarized light of the cosmic microwave background

evidence.text: How can CMB polarisation reveal cosmic birefringence associated with dark-sector physics and distinguish vacuum-generated primordial gravitational waves from waves sourced by matter during inflation?

sources.title: Investigating the origin of CMB large-scale features using LiteBIRD and CMB-S4

evidence.text: Can projected LiteBIRD and CMB-S4 temperature/polarization measurements reject large-scale features if the universe is featureless, detect features if present, and distinguish primordial features from late-time origins?

sources.title: Planck 2013 results. XXV. Searches for cosmic strings and other topological defects

evidence.text: Power-spectrum pipelines use an unconnected segment model with one-scale network evolution coupled to CMBACT, or field-simulation unequal-time stress-energy correlators (UETCs), decomposed into scalar/vector/tensor parts, diagonalized and supplied to modified CMBEASY. COSMOMC fits the additional defect fraction.

sources.title: Planck 2015 results. XVI. Isotropy and statistics of the CMB

evidence.text: Null tests compare equivalently processed observations and FFP8 simulations, typically using 1000 realizations. Methods include variance, skewness, kurtosis, and a low-resolution multivariate-Gaussian quadratic-form test; poorly conditioned covariance matrices are treated by removing degenerate eigenmodes.

sources.title: CMB-S4 Science Book, First Edition

evidence.text: Tensor forecasts use Fisher methods and scaled achieved BICEP2/Keck power-spectrum covariance matrices to represent observing losses. Authors report agreement at several common parameter points with another Fisher code and a map-based code; the latter permits non-Gaussian, spatially varying foregrounds.

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters

evidence.text: Lensing-potential power is reconstructed from the connected four-point function and analyzed with an approximately Gaussian band-power likelihood over 8 ≤ L ≤ 400. Correlations with the two-point spectra are neglected as negligible at Planck sensitivity.

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. IX. Constraints on primordial non-Gaussianity

evidence.text: FFP10 simulations calibrate linear corrections, errors, and validation tests. Most pipelines use 300 realizations; Modal pipelines use 160. Estimator and foreground-cleaning comparisons provide internal cross-checks.

sources.title: CMB-S4 Science Case, Reference Design, and Project Plan

evidence.text: Primordial-spectrum forecasts use generalized slow roll and a Fisher analysis varying six ΛCDM parameters plus 40 logarithmically spaced source-function coefficients over 0.5 < s/Mpc < 4870, interpolated with a natural spline.

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence tomography and calibration independence with reionization signals in the CMB

evidence.text: Can separately measuring rotation of reionization and recombination CMB polarization produce a calibration-independent birefringence observable and constrain when the responsible new physics acted?

sources.title: Measuring dark energy clustering with CMB-galaxy correlations

evidence.text: How well can future CMB–galaxy correlations constrain the physical scale and amplitude of dark-energy clustering, and thereby test canonical single-scalar quintessence?

sources.title: Constraints on Wrapped DBI Inflation in a Warped Throat

evidence.text: Could observable CMB modes originate in the nearly constant-warp region where the AdS approximation fails?

sources.title: Planck 2018 results. X. Constraints on inflation

evidence.text: What do the Planck 2018 CMB measurements imply for inflationary observables, single-field dynamics, primordial spectral features, adiabaticity and statistical isotropy?

sources.title: Simultaneous determination of the cosmic birefringence and miscalibrated polarization angles from CMB experiments

evidence.text: Can CMB EB measurements determine a uniform cosmic birefringence angle β simultaneously with an instrumental polarization-angle miscalibration α, using Galactic foregrounds to distinguish their effects?

sources.title: Improved constraints on cosmic birefringence from the WMAP and Planck cosmic microwave background polarization data

evidence.text: Can joint WMAP and Planck polarization cross-spectra improve inference of isotropic cosmic birefringence while separating instrumental angle errors and Galactic foreground EB correlations, and does the inferred rotation depend on frequency?

sources.title: Planck PR4 (NPIPE) map-space cosmic birefringence

evidence.text: What isotropic rotation and large-scale birefringence dipole are inferred from Planck PR4 polarization using map-space peak analysis, and how do foreground masks and extrema splits expose possible systematic effects?

sources.title: Cosmic Birefringence from the Planck Data Release 4

evidence.text: Does the Planck PR4 polarization EB signal support cosmic birefringence, and how robust is its inferred angle to instrumental systematics, frequency selection, Galactic masks and intrinsic foreground EB?

sources.title: Improved Constraints on Primordial Gravitational Waves using Planck, WMAP, and BICEP/Keck Observations through the 2018 Observing Season

evidence.text: What limits on primordial tensor perturbations follow from degree-scale CMB B modes after separating lensing, Galactic dust and synchrotron using the BICEP/Keck observations through 2018 together with WMAP and Planck maps?

sources.title: Planck 2015 results. XX. Constraints on inflation

evidence.text: What do full-mission Planck CMB measurements imply for inflationary spectra, potential models, primordial tensors, spectral features and nonadiabatic initial conditions?

sources.title: Detection of $B$-Mode Polarization at Degree Angular Scales by BICEP2

evidence.text: Is there degree-scale B-mode power beyond lensed ΛCDM, can instrumental effects or foregrounds explain it, and what tensor amplitude follows under a primordial-tensor interpretation?

sources.title: Probing Cosmic Inflation with the LiteBIRD Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Survey

evidence.text: Can a full-sky, multifrequency CMB polarization satellite detect primordial tensor B modes or constrain well-motivated inflationary models while controlling foregrounds and instrumental errors at δr ≈ 10⁻³?

sources.title: Joint Analysis of BICEP2/$Keck  Array$ and $Planck$ Data

evidence.text: Can joint BICEP2/Keck and Planck polarization spectra separate Galactic foregrounds from primordial tensor B-modes and constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio r?

sources.title: Improved Constraints on Cosmology and Foregrounds from BICEP2 and Keck Array Cosmic Microwave Background Data with Inclusion of 95 GHz Band

evidence.text: How do the first Keck Array 95 GHz observations improve separation of primordial CMB B-modes from polarized dust and synchrotron, and the resulting constraint on the tensor-to-scalar ratio?

sources.title: New Extraction of the Cosmic Birefringence from the Planck 2018 Polarization Data

evidence.text: Can a spatially uniform cosmic birefringence angle β be distinguished from detector polarization-angle miscalibration using the different responses of CMB and Galactic foreground polarization?

sources.title: Skewon field and cosmic wave propagation

evidence.text: Which skewon components are compatible with cosmic electromagnetic propagation without birefringence or amplification/dissipation, and how strongly does the historically measured CMB blackbody spectrum constrain them?

sources.title: Inflation from wrapped branes

evidence.text: Can outward motion with decreasing gamma improve the probe regime while fitting CMB-scale observations?
